title: Senior/Staff/Principal Engineer
description: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. This is a general track for Senior+ (Senior/Staff/Principal) Engineers in any team at Canonical. After the first round of interviews we will establish which teams might be an excellent fit, and progress your application with them. At Canonical a Senior+ Engineer is not only an outstanding software architect and coder, they also demonstrate the leadership qualities needed to rally a team or department to ship outstanding products. A Senior+ Engineer partners with other Engineering leaders (Managers, Directors, VPs) to take joint responsibility for outcomes at team, department and company level. We hire based on academic results and proven execution, and we select those with a passion for open-source software, innovation, and cutting-edge technology. In this role, you will make a significant contribution in Canonical's portfolio through high-quality code, technical leadership, team motivation and direction, exceptional design, and crisp documentation. As a Senior+ Engineer you'll drive the architecture, design and evolution of high-impact open source software. Our teams work at every level of the stack. From the kernel and system software at the core of Ubuntu through to major language runtimes and the bleeding-edge of cloud automation and distributed systems, you'll have the opportunity to work on complex but highly rewarding projects. Our teams also build the services which deliver Ubuntu to the world, on cloud, devices, servers and PCs. Additionally, this role will give you the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and ensure seamless software operations at scale. Location: we have remote opportunities for Senior Engineers in every time zone. The role entails Leading design and architecture of an impactful open source project Coding in Golang, Rust, Python, C/C++ or Typescript / React Collaborating proactively with a globally distributed team Mentoring, developing and advising colleagues in their career progression Displaying technical leadership in Canonical and our communities Debugging issues and producing high-quality code to fix them Contributing to technical documentation with the aim to make it the best of its kind Working from home with global travel twice annually for company events What we are looking for in you An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations Technical leadership as well as team motivation, direction and pace Deep experience with at least one of Go, Rust, Python or C Conscientiousness and detail orientation, with a focus on performance Excellent communication skills including professional written and spoken English Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each Nice-to-have skills Depending on your eventual team, you might also bring experience with Container technologies such as LXD, Docker and Kubernetes Highly concurrent, distributed systems Performance engineering – from kernel to web – benchmarks, optimization Software security – fuzzing, tabletop threat models, analysis, audit Build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation Public clouds or OpenStack Debian/Ubuntu packaging Systems programming or scalable web services Deep quality and test engineering Web or Flutter front-end experience REST and gRPC API experience SQL and NoSQL data store expertise What we offer you We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally. Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person Personal learning and development budget

title: Community Engineer (multiple roles and seniority levels)
description: Our ambition is to set a standard of excellence when it comes to serving the open source ecosystem. This is your chance to be a part of that as a Community Engineer at Canonical . We are building community management at scale. We have multiple positions available, at different seniority levels. All applications and candidates are handled through this single entry point. To improve your chances of success in this application, read our advice on how to get a job at Canonical. The role of a Community Engineer The Community team at Canonical enables community leaders and participants to get things done, co-ordinating with Canonical teams and ensuring that community processes are efficient and well run. We don't do the work of the community, but we facilitate that work to ensure that energetic and ambitious community members with their own vision of open source can benefit from the work Canonical does and bring their own flavor of Ubuntu into being, to meet the needs and express the interests of their community. You will play a key role in designing, executing, and scaling initiatives that foster a thriving community. This is an exciting opportunity for a technically proficient person who is passionate about open source software, Linux, and sustainable community building. In this role, you will support community initiatives with your technical skills and strong organizational skills. You work hand in hand with developers to smooth processes and integrate community plans with Canonical plans for maximum impact. You can encourage and facilitate the creation of new technical projects that enhance the community contribution experience, and you represent community interests to Canonical teams. You will lead complex, multi-disciplinary programs from conception through launch, working closely with Developer Relations engineers, technical authors, product managers, marketing teams, engineering teams, and external partners. You will support and engage with volunteer developers in the Ubuntu community, addressing their concerns and helping them to create successful tools. You will help to ensure their success and the overall autonomy and sustainability of projects. You will provide the content and technical support to ensure the community stays engaged and informed. This will include regular blog and social media posts about community initiatives, events, accomplishments, and collaborative efforts between Canonical and the Ubuntu community. You will communicate effectively with developers and software engineers and represent not only the Ubuntu community but Canonical as a contributor to the wider Linux ecosystem. Our team attends conferences and expos, and talks about technical community projects and their development processes. Location : These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe. What your day will look like Write high quality content to promote and support community initiatives Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions to community problems Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events Potential opportunity to travel more if you wish Nurture community contributions to Ubuntu Engage with the Ubuntu community through Discourse, Matrix, social media, conferences, etc. Represent Ubuntu via speaking engagements at events and conferences Support the engagement by Canonical teams into the open source ecosystem What we are looking for in you You love technology and working with brilliant people You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated You have experience with developer tools and open source projects You have a clear public record of accomplishments (talks, blog posts, GitHub, X, etc.) You have interest and experience with some of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, DevOps, software development, testing and QA, package management, container technology You can work autonomously and assume full ownership of objectives as needed You can be flexible with your time and enjoy working with new technology in a fast-paced environment You are experienced working with open source communities and understand the workflow of volunteer contributors You have experience in (technical) program management and have excellent organizational, communication and interpersonal skills Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring Experience with community management Experience with Developer advocacy Experience as a software developer Examples of contributions to the Ubuntu Community Experience with contributing to open source projects What we offer colleagues We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. title: Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer
description: Company Description Sheba Aviation Service PLC is an aviation services provider based in Ethiopia, focused on delivering reliable and safe aircraft operations and maintenance solutions. The company is committed to high technical standards, regulatory compliance, and safety in all aspects of its services. Team members work with modern aircraft and systems in a professional environment that encourages continuous learning and skills development. Sheba Aviation Service PLC values integrity, precision, and collaboration to ensure operational excellence and quality service for its customers. Role Description The Licensed Aircraft Maintenance Engineer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Ethiopia. The engineer is responsible for performing scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on aircraft and aircraft systems, including inspections, repairs, adjustments, and component replacements in accordance with manufacturer specifications and regulatory requirements. Day-to-day tasks include diagnosing technical issues, troubleshooting system malfunctions, ensuring airworthiness through detailed documentation and sign-off, and coordinating with operations and maintenance teams to minimize aircraft downtime. The role also involves maintaining accurate maintenance records, adhering to safety and quality standards, supporting audits and inspections, and participating in continuous improvement and training activities to keep skills current with evolving aviation technologies. Qualifications Strong Aircraft Maintenance experience, with the ability to perform inspections, repairs, and preventive maintenance on various types of aircraft. In-depth knowledge of Aircraft and Aircraft Systems, including structures, avionics, engines, hydraulics, and electrical systems. Proficient Troubleshooting skills for identifying, analyzing, and resolving mechanical and system-related issues efficiently. Demonstrated understanding of Airworthiness requirements, regulations, and compliance procedures, including accurate documentation and sign-off. Valid aircraft maintenance engineer license or equivalent certification, recognized by relevant aviation authorities. Previous experience in a commercial, corporate, or general aviation maintenance environment is highly beneficial. Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, engineering drawings, and maintenance documentation in English. Strong attention to detail, safety-focused mindset, and capability to work effectively in a team and in a fast-paced operational setting. Willingness to work shifts, weekends, and respond to operational demands as required.

title: General Manager – Ethiopia
description: Role Overview CIMC Tianda is seeking a locally based General Manager to lead its airport equipment installation and maintenance operations in Ethiopia. The successful candidate will take overall responsibility for the local team and airport service contracts, covering business performance, customer relations, installation management, operations and maintenance, HSE, personnel and subcontractor management. The position requires a hands-on manager who can maintain reliable airport operations while supporting the continued development of the local business. Key Responsibilities Assume overall responsibility for local business performance, including budgeting, profit and loss, cost control, cash flow and operating forecasts. Manage airport maintenance contracts, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, SLAs and equipment availability targets. Manage airport equipment installation projects, including installation planning, site coordination, manpower arrangements, subcontractor management, progress control, quality, safety, testing, commissioning and handover. Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance, 24/7 breakdown response, spare parts, maintenance records and subcontractor performance. Maintain effective relationships with the airport, customers, government authorities and other local stakeholders. Support business development, contract renewals, quotations, variations, claims, invoicing and accounts receivable collection. Lead the local organization, including recruitment, shift arrangements, training, performance management and employee relations. Implement HSE and safety management systems, ensuring compliance with airport requirements and local regulations. Monitor contract profitability and implement measures to improve installation efficiency, operational performance and service quality. Submit regular business, financial and operational reports in English to the Regional Director. Coordinate major commercial, technical, installation and personnel matters with the Regional Director and headquarters. Mandatory Requirements Must have held a middle-management or above position at Addis Ababa Bole International Airport. This must have been an actual employment role based at the airport, with responsibility for airport operations, ground handling, airport equipment or GSE maintenance, or on-site contracted services. Project supply, installation work or occasional contact with the airport as a customer does not meet this requirement. Proven experience managing operational teams, technicians, shifts and subcontractors. Working knowledge of airport operations, installation and maintenance management, service-level requirements and safety management. Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, operating costs and customer relationships. Able to lead business discussions and prepare management reports in English. Based in Addis Ababa or able to work there permanently, with the legal right to work in Ethiopia. Willing to remain available for major operational issues outside normal working hours. Preferred Qualifications Previous General Manager, Operations Director, Country Manager or equivalent experience. Experience with passenger boarding bridges, GSE or other electromechanical airport equipment. Experience in full P&L management, installation project management, contract negotiation, claims and collections. Familiarity with Ethiopian employment practices and airport stakeholder management. Application Please submit an English CV clearly stating the employer, job title, employment dates and responsibilities for the middle-management or above role held at Addis Ababa Bole International Airport. Please also indicate your notice period, earliest available start date and salary expectations.

title: Office Manager
description: Company Description Ephtah Specialty Coffee, founded in 2021, is a specialty coffee export company dedicated to delivering the finest Ethiopian coffee to global clients. The organization prioritizes quality, exceptional after-sales support, and flexible customer service tailored to specific client needs. Ephtah emphasizes fully traceable, socially responsible supply chains to support sustainable growth of the Ethiopian coffee industry. Role Description The Office Manager is responsible for overseeing daily office operations and ensuring a well-organized, efficient work environment. This full-time, on-site role is based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia and includes coordinating schedules, managing office supplies and equipment, and maintaining accurate records and documentation. The Office Manager will support administrative processes, assist with basic finance and logistics tasks, and ensure smooth communication between internal teams and external partners. The role also involves handling visitor inquiries, supporting customer service activities, and helping to implement office policies and procedures aligned with Ephtah’s values and business objectives. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with colleagues, suppliers, and clients. Candidates should possess Office Administration and Administrative Assistance skills to manage daily operations, documentation, and scheduling. Candidates should possess practical knowledge of Office Equipment to ensure proper use, basic troubleshooting, and coordination of maintenance. Relevant experience in office management or administrative roles, preferably in import/export, logistics, or the coffee/agricultural sector. Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency with common office software (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets, email, and collaboration tools). Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and uphold the company’s values of integrity, transparency, and community focus. Degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field is preferred.

title: Solution Architect
description: Join our Team About this opportunity: Lead end-to-end technical delivery of RAN projects at Ericsson, covering solution design, implementation, optimization, acceptance, and customer engagement. Strong expertise in 4G/LTE is required; 5G knowledge is a plus. Deep Ericsson product knowledge is mandatory. What you will do: Lead RAN project delivery from design through deployment, optimization, and customer handover. Define and validate RAN solutions aligned with customer requirements, Ericsson standards, and network strategy. Manage design activities including coverage, capacity, parameter planning, and feature implementation. Drive tuning and optimization to improve coverage, quality, capacity, and user experience. Lead acceptance activities — test planning, KPI definition, issue resolution, and customer sign-off. Serve as the primary technical interface for customers and senior stakeholders. Coordinate across project managers, RF engineers, delivery teams, and subcontractors. Identify and mitigate technical risks, dependencies, and deviations. Ensure compliance with Ericsson processes, governance models, quality, and security standards. Lead design reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and executive steering meetings. Translate technical topics into clear business impacts and recommendations for senior management. Support presales, bid, and solution validation activities when needed. Maintain documentation, acceptance evidence, and handover material. Coach RAN engineers and promote knowledge sharing across delivery teams. The skills you bring: Bachelor's in Telecommunications, Electrical or Computer Engineering, or related field. Extensive experience in RAN architecture, design, deployment, optimization, and acceptance. Strong practical knowledge of 4G/LTE; 5G NR knowledge is an advantage. Mandatory: proven expertise in Ericsson RAN systems, products, tools, and delivery processes. Experience leading RAN projects in customer-facing environments. Proficient in RAN KPIs, performance analysis, troubleshooting, and optimization. Strong grasp of project governance, risk management, and process compliance. Excellent communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills. Able to work independently, prioritize effectively, and make decisions under pressure. Open to travel and international/multicultural project environments. Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next. What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.
